# EuroGPU.watch

> Live GPU rental price tracker for Europe. Filters by EU incorporation, GDPR DPA availability and US CLOUD Act exposure. Prices are fetched from public provider APIs/pages every ~15 min; last update 2026-10-25T23:55:11+00:00 UTC.

## Data
- [Live prices JSON](https://paubuilds.github.io/eurogpu-watch/data/prices.json): every row has provider, gpu, usd_hr, native price/currency, source URL, fetched_at
- [Provider compliance JSON](https://paubuilds.github.io/eurogpu-watch/providers.json): HQ, EU incorporation, DPA, CLOUD Act exposure, claims with source URLs and verification status
